column4: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
column5: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'
column6:
SELECT T1.name, T1.result, T1.bulgarian_commander
FROM battle AS T1
JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.lost_in_battle
WHERE T2.location != 'English Channel';

column4: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
column5: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
column6:
SELECT b.id, b.name
FROM battle b
JOIN death d ON b.id = d.caused_by_ship_id
GROUP BY b.id, b.name
HAVING SUM(d.killed) > 10;

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
column5: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'
column6:
SELECT d.note, d.killed, d.injured
FROM death d
JOIN ship s ON d.caused_by_ship_id = s.id
WHERE s.tonnage = 't';

column4: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
column5: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders  =  4 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Cylinders = 4 ORDER BY T1.Horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM car_makers AS T1 INNER JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.MakeId INNER JOIN cars_data AS T3 ON T2.MakeId = T3.MakeId WHERE T1.FullName = 'General Motors' OR T3.Weight > 3500;

column4: What is the model for the car with a weight smaller than the average?
column5: SELECT T1.model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Weight  <  (SELECT avg(Weight) FROM CARS_DATA)
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data)

column4: List all song names by singers above the average age.
column5: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)
column6:
SELECT s.Song_Name 
FROM singer s 
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID 
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID 
WHERE s.Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer)

column4: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
column6:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name 
FROM singer s 
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID 
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID 
WHERE c.Year = '2014';

column4: What is the name and country of origin of every singer who has a song with the word 'Hey' in its title?
column5: SELECT name ,  country FROM singer WHERE song_name LIKE '%Hey%'
column6:
SELECT s.Name, s.Country FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN song ON c.concert_ID = song.concert_ID
WHERE song.Song_Name LIKE '%Hey%'

column4: List the emails of the professionals who live in the state of Hawaii or the state of Wisconsin.

column6: SELECT T3.email_address FROM Professionals AS T1 INNER JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id INNER JOIN States AS T3 ON T2.state_code = T3.state_code WHERE T3.state_name IN ('Hawaii', 'Wisconsin');

column4: List each owner's first name, last name, and the size of his for her dog.
column5: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T2.size_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id
column6:

FROM Owners O
JOIN Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.owner_id

column4: What are each professional's first name and description of the treatment they have performed?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN Treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code
column6: SELECT T3.first_name, T4.treatment_type_description FROM Treatments AS T1 INNER JOIN Professionals AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id INNER JOIN Treatment_Types AS T4 ON T1.treatment_type_code = T4.treatment_type_code INNER JOIN Dogs AS T5 ON T1.dog_id = T5.dog_id;

column4: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.
column5: SELECT professional_id ,  last_name ,  cell_number FROM Professionals WHERE state  =  'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >  2
column6:
SELECT T3.professional_id, T3.last_name, T3.cell_number
FROM Owners AS T1
JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id
JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id = T3.dog_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana' OR COUNT(T3.treatment_id) > 2;

column4: For each shop, return the number of employees working there and the name of the shop.
column5: SELECT count(*) ,  t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t2.name
column6:

FROM shop s

column4: How many friends does each student have?

FROM Highschooler H1

column4: Show the names of high school students and their corresponding number of friends.
column5: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id
column6:

FROM Highschooler H
JOIN Friend F ON H.ID = F.student_id

column4: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
column6:
SELECT DISTINCT T3.name 
FROM Friend AS T1 
JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.ID 
JOIN Likes AS T3 ON T1.student_id = T3.student_id 
WHERE T2.name IN (
    SELECT T4.name 
    FROM Friend AS T5 
    JOIN Highschooler AS T6 ON T5.student_id = T6.ID 
    WHERE T6.name IN (
        SELECT T7.name 
        FROM Likes AS T8 
        JOIN Highschooler AS T9 ON T8.liked_id = T9.ID 
        GROUP BY T9.name 
        HAVING COUNT(T8.student_id) > 0
    )
)

column4: What are years of founding for orchestras that have had more than a single performance?

column6: SELECT T2.Year_of_Founded FROM orchestra AS T1 INNER JOIN performance AS T2 ON T1.Orchestra_ID = T2.Orchestra_ID GROUP BY T1.Orchestra_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.Performance_ID) > 1;

column4: Find the average and maximum age for each type of pet.
column5: SELECT avg(pet_age) ,  max(pet_age) ,  pettype FROM pets GROUP BY pettype
column6:
SELECT p.PetType, AVG(s.Age) AS AverageAge, MAX(s.Age) AS MaxAge
FROM Has_Pet hp
JOIN Student s ON hp.StuID = s.StuID
JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
GROUP BY p.PetType;

column4: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
column5: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
column6:
SELECT p.property_name 
FROM Properties p 
JOIN Ref_Property_Types pt ON p.property_type_code = pt.property_type_code

column4: Show the names of singers and the total sales of their songs.

column4: Find the series name and country of the tv channel that is playing some cartoons directed by Ben Jones and Michael Chang?
column5: SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Michael Chang' INTERSECT SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'

FROM Cartoon AS T1 
JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id

column4: What is the area code in which the most voters voted?
column5: SELECT T1.area_code FROM area_code_state AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.state  =  T2.state GROUP BY T1.area_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
column6:
SELECT area_code FROM AREA_CODE_STATE WHERE state = 
(SELECT state FROM VOTES GROUP BY state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

column4: List the area codes in which voters voted both for the contestant 'Tabatha Gehling' and the contestant 'Kelly Clauss'.
column5: SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling' INTERSECT SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Kelly Clauss'
column6:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.area_code 
FROM AREA_CODE_STATE AS T1 
JOIN VOTES AS T2 ON T1.state = T2.state 
WHERE T2.contestant_number IN (
    SELECT contestant_number 
    FROM CONTESTANTS 
    WHERE contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
) 
AND T2.contestant_number IN (
    SELECT contestant_number 
    FROM CONTESTANTS 
    WHERE contestant_name = 'Kelly Clauss'
);

column4: What are the create dates, states, and phone numbers of the votes that were for the contestant named 'Tabatha Gehling'?
column5: SELECT T2.created ,  T2.state ,  T2.phone_number FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling'
column6: SELECT T3.created, T3.state, T3.phone_number FROM CONTESTANTS AS T1 INNER JOIN VOTES AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number = T2.contestant_number INNER JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE AS T3 ON T2.state = T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling';

column4: What are the African countries that have a  population less than any country in Asia?
column5: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT max(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN city AS T3 ON T1.Code = T3.CountryCode INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T4 ON T1.Code = T4.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent = 'Africa' AND T1.Population < ( SELECT MIN(Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia' )

column4: What are the names of nations where both English and French are official languages?
column5: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM countrylanguage AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Language = 'English' INTERSECT SELECT T2.Name FROM countrylanguage AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Language = 'French'

column4: Return the country codes for countries that do not speak English.

column6: SELECT T1.Code FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language != 'English'

column4: List the first name and birth date of all players from the country with code USA.
column5: SELECT first_name ,  birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code  =  'USA'
column6:
SELECT p.first_name, p.birth_date
FROM players p
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE p.country_code = 'USA';

column4: How many car models are produced in the usa?
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';
column6:
SELECT COUNT(T2.Model) 
FROM countries AS T1 
JOIN continents AS T3 ON T1.Continent = T3.ContId 
JOIN car_makers AS T4 ON T1.CountryId = T4.Country 
JOIN model_list AS T5 ON T4.Id = T5.Maker 
WHERE T3.Continent = 'USA';
